title: anthemis cretica subsp. subcinerea
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. subcinerea, commonly known as Greek chamomile, is a subspecies of the Anthemis cretica plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Greek chamomile include sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Anthemis cretica subsp. subcinerea include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy.
